value.name: recognize arrangement has failed
value.description: Asha realizes from the report that the current arrangement cannot hold and that the staffing and specialized care are already gone.
evidence: Asha understood that the question of whether the arrangement could hold had already been answered by the report itself. The staffing was gone. The specialized care was gone.

value.name: realize new plan must be built tonight
value.description: Asha understands that they must build something new before her phone alarm pulls her back to work at six.
evidence: Whatever they decided tonight would not be a renegotiation of what existed but the building of something else, and it would have to be built before her phone alarm went off at six and pulled her back to the Serrano closing.

value.name: lucia asks where to place her
value.description: Lucia quietly asks Asha where they are supposed to put the person they are discussing.
evidence: Lucia lifted her eyes finally, not all the way to Asha's face but to the collar of her coat, and asked, in a voice pitched not to carry into the room behind them, where they were supposed to put her.

value.name: asha admits she has no answer
value.description: Asha cannot answer Lucia's question and recognizes how much has been carried alone for a month.
evidence: Asha did not have an answer.

she realized that the next several hours were not going to be about deciding anything cleanly; they were going to be about finding, tonight, a place and a plan concrete enough that neither of them would have to leave this hallway pretending the problem had been handled.

value.name: asha moves closer and lowers her voice
value.description: Asha releases Lucia's sleeve, closes the distance between them, and speaks quietly so they will not be overheard.
evidence: Asha let her hand slide from Lucia's sleeve and closed the small distance between them instead, lowering her voice until it would not carry past the doorframe behind her.

value.name: asha asks who knows about staffing drop
value.description: Asha asks Lucia who else is aware that the staffing has dropped.
evidence: She asked who else knew the staffing had dropped

value.name: lucia retrieves second document
value.description: Instead of answering, Lucia reaches into her bag and pulls out a second document.
